crossRefs.note: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

parallels.note: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

translations.web: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
translations.bsb: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
translations.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
translations.asv: For she said, If I touch but his garments, I shall be made whole.
